realm_description: The high, thin-aired peaks where thought is clearest. Those drawn here chase vision, discovery, and the kind of knowledge that only comes from climbing higher than everyone else.

primary.label: Oracle
primary.description: Notices what hasn't happened yet — through a mind that sees connections others miss.
primary.guiding_promise: I will speak the pattern I see, even when no one wants to hear it yet.
primary.shadow_description: Mistakes a hunch for a prophecy, and loses the trust of anyone who asks for proof.

secondary.label: Technocrat
secondary.description: Optimises for efficiency; people-politics is noise to filter out.
secondary.guiding_promise: I solve what others accept — with data, not drama.
secondary.shadow_description: Optimizes the system so completely that the people inside it become variables, not lives.

wheel.central_question: Should we speak the pattern before it's proven, or build only what's already real?

growth.label: Technocrat
growth.description: Optimises for efficiency; people-politics is noise to filter out.
growth.guiding_promise: I solve what others accept — with data, not drama.
growth.shadow_description: Optimizes the system so completely that the people inside it become variables, not lives.

other_ally.label: Visionary
other_ally.description: Sees the shape of what doesn't exist yet; sketches futures vivid enough to pull the world forward.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will keep dreaming even when the world insists on staying as it is.
other_ally.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

quarter.label: Historian
quarter.description: Gathers what happened — triumphs and shameful parts alike — so no one can pretend it didn't.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will remember honestly, even when forgetting would be easier.
quarter.shadow_description: Cannot let the past go, and lets old grievance calcify into bitterness dressed as memory.

opposite.label: Builder
opposite.description: Driven to make things real with their own hands.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will make something real that endures long after I am gone.
opposite.shadow_description: Cannot put the work down long enough to notice what it has quietly cost them.

realmmate.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

wheel.compatible_text: Visionary · Inventor — fellow travelers of The Mountain Belt.
